results.detail: Update the Canvas first (fix-the-prompt-first), then rerun. A valid specs/reviews/sensor-waivers.json entry can cover a deliberate mismatch.
Assign the file to its owning story in component-map.md, then rerun. empty_map (the map parsed to zero entries) also blocks.
A previously-passing e2e spec or prior contract check now fails — this is a regression, not a flake (quarantined flakes are excluded). Fix the regression.

Re-run the evaluation driving the app through the user path (browser_click / browser_fill_form), not browser_evaluate — that is permitted only for axe-core injection on an accessibility entry. A contracted check with no evidence entry is a silent skip: execute it, or record the honest "untested" verdict. Reads specs/reviews/evaluator-evidence.json, so run it after the evaluator returns.
Batch the query, or move the sync call off the async path. Unbounded-load findings are WARN only.
